ranked_facts.concept_key: Medical history: chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD)
ranked_facts.why: The patient's medical history of COPD is more strongly associated with Right Bundle Branch Block (RBBB) with Cardiac Arrest due to Hypoxemia from COPD Exacerbation, which is a subtype of Primary Cardiac Disorder, than with Acute Exacerbation of Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD), which is a subtype of Pulmonary Disorder.

ranked_facts.concept_key: ECG finding: prolonged QRS duration with rsR' complexes in lead V1
ranked_facts.why: The ECG finding of prolonged QRS duration with rsR' complexes in lead V1 is more characteristic of Arrhythmogenic Right Ventricular Cardiomyopathy (ARVC) with Cardiac Arrest, which is a subtype of Primary Cardiac Disorder, than of Right Bundle Branch Block (RBBB) with Cardiac Arrest due to Hypoxemia from COPD Exacerbation.
